intro: One glass of kopi ais (kopi susu) at a mamak or kopitiam is about 170 kcal. Most of the calories come from condensed milk and sugar, not the coffee itself.
diet: Yes, but watch how often. One glass a day is still okay if the rest of your food is in check. The problem is when it becomes 2-3 glasses a day. That's like adding an extra plate of rice. Try cutting the sweetness first. Your taste buds will adjust in a week or two.
tips: Order 'kopi ais kurang manis' or 'kopi C ais kosong' (evaporated milk, no sugar).
Limit it to one glass a day, for example only at breakfast.
If you want a second glass, make it kopi-O ais kosong.

swap.name: Kopi C ais kosong
swap.why: Still milky from the evaporated milk, but no condensed milk or sugar. You save over 100 kcal per glass.

faq.q: Can kopi ais make me hungry faster?
faq.a: High sugar can make your energy go up and down quickly. Some people feel hungry again soon after. Having it with food that has protein can help.

faq.q: What's the difference between kopi susu and kopi C?
faq.a: Kopi susu uses condensed milk. Kopi C uses evaporated milk and sugar. Kopi C kosong has no sugar at all.

faq.q: When is the best time to drink kopi ais?
faq.a: Most people have it in the morning or at lunch. Avoid late afternoon if caffeine affects your sleep, because poor sleep can make it harder to control your appetite.
